input.quote: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: Section 14.1 (Customer Data and Customer pre-existing IP), 14.3 (Vendor Technology with the Section 13.2 perpetual licence) and 14.4 (no joint ownership) are all consistent with the playbook. The failure is Section 14.2: Vendor takes exclusive ownership of every Deliverable created specifically for Customer (per the § 1.4 definition), and the only licence back is revocable, non-transferable and limited to the Order Form term. That misses the preferred position (Customer ownership by assignment) and also fails the fallback, which requires a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables. Section 13.2's perpetual licence does not cure this because it covers only Vendor Technology embedded in a Deliverable, not the Deliverable itself. Redline flips the assignment to Customer while expressly preserving Vendor Technology under 14.3; the licence-back fallback is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Reverse Deliverable ownership: Vendor assigns Deliverables to Customer, retaining Vendor Technology under 14.3.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We own the work product we pay for, so we have flipped Section 14.2 so Vendor assigns each Deliverable to us; Vendor's pre-existing Vendor Technology is unaffected and remains protected by Sections 14.3 and 13.2. If Vendor must retain title, our fallback is a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Deliverables for our business, in place of the current revocable, term-limited licence.

ops.oldText: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: 14.2 Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest in and to each Deliverable upon creation. Vendor retains Vendor Technology in accordance with Section 14.3.
